services.name: Seal and Harbor Cruise
services.desc: About The seals of Monomoy are a rare treat to be seen close up. You will glide through narrow channels and into isolated lagoons where hundreds, seals swim and lay out along the shore. You will also see different types of seabirds! Although rare, there is a chance of seeing a great white shark swim by too! One of the best ocean fun trips for your entire family.
